description: Dev predictions: deployed partial-int8 ONNX (model.int8.onnx, identical md5 to model.int8_noattn_nodown.onnx) via experiments/paws/common.onnx_probs (length-sorted batches of 32, 8 threads); bit-identical to the p4 dev probs behind FROZEN dev_metrics.accuracy_int8=0.885. Dev is out-of-sample: p2_train.labelset drops all seed and dev uids and the pseudo-labels cover pool texts only. Re-predicting test did NOT reproduce the frozen test probs to 1e-4 (mean |diff| 0.013, corr 0.997, 98.7% decision agreement): dynamic int8 activation scales depend on batch composition and the exact test batching is unrecorded. The same noise level on dev (batch-1 vs batch-32: mean |diff| 0.012) leaves the selection unchanged (platt both times, a 0.527 vs 0.526, b 0.831 vs 0.824). Method chosen by 5-fold CV NLL on the 200 dev examples, refit on all 200.
